tools.name: get_employee_payslip
tools.description: Reads a payslip PDF for an employee from the payroll archive and returns its extracted text. The payslip is identified by the file name given by the caller.

params.name: payslip_file
params.description: File name of the payslip, e.g. 2024-03_jdoe.txt

tools.name: load_leave_policy_document
tools.description: Loads the text of a company leave policy document from the HR policies folder and returns it, optionally truncated to a maximum number of characters.

params.name: document_name
params.description: Name of the policy document file, e.g. parental_leave.md

params.name: max_chars
params.description: Maximum number of characters to return

tools.name: summarize_timesheet_csv
tools.description: Reads a timesheet CSV from the timesheets folder and returns the total hours worked and the number of entries for the file.

params.name: timesheet_path
params.description: Relative path of the timesheet CSV within the timesheets folder
